message.content:
Based on the image provided, here is the evaluation of the chemical engineering flash-separation teaching app:

**1. Drawing Sheet Frame and Title Block**
*   **Yes.** There is a clear, light gray rectangular border defining the drawing sheet area.
*   **Yes.** There is a title block located in the bottom-right corner of the sheet. It contains the text **"FLASH SEPARATION"**, followed by "PROCESS FLOW DIAGRAM", and "SHEET 1 OF 1 · REV. A".

**2. Stream Lines vs. Unit Labels**
*   **Yes.** The stream lines are routed cleanly to avoid overlapping with text.
    *   Stream 1 connects F-101 to E-101 without crossing the labels.
    *   Stream 2 connects E-101 to V-101.
    *   Streams 3 (Gas) and 4 (Liquid) exit from the top and bottom of V-101 respectively. The lines extend horizontally away from the vessel, ensuring they do not cross the **"V-101"** tag or the **"FLASH DRUM"** name located to the right of the unit.

**3. Margin Annotations**
*   **Yes.** The annotations **"GAS TO RECYCLE"** (top right) and **"LIQUID AMMONIA"** (bottom right) are fully visible within the boundaries of the drawing sheet frame. They are not clipped by the edge.

**4. Legend**
*   **Yes.** There is a legend located in the bottom-left corner of the interface (outside the main drawing sheet). It displays a compass rose (**N**) and defines the line styles: **"PROCESS GAS"** (solid line), **"LOOP GAS"** (dashed line), and **"PRODUCT"** (thicker solid/greenish line).

**5. Overall Professional Look**
*   **Yes.** The interface has a very professional, clean, and modern aesthetic suitable for engineering education (reminiscent of high-end CAD or simulation software like SimSci or Aspen).
*   **Visuals:** It uses a minimalist color palette (grays, blacks, whites) with subtle color-coding for streams (blue for gas, green for liquid/product).
*   **Typography:** Clear, sans-serif fonts are used for both tags (F-101, etc.) and descriptions.
*   **Layout:** The layout is balanced with a main canvas on the left and an instructional sidebar ("Your first flowsheet") on the right, which enhances the teaching aspect.

**Quote of what is seen:**
> "The interface displays a **Process Flow Diagram** titled **'FLASH SEPARATION'** in the bottom-right title block. It features three units: **F-101 SYNGAS FEED**, **E-101 CHILLER**, and **V-101 FLASH DRUM**. Four numbered streams connect these units, with stream 3 labeled **'GAS TO RECYCLE'** and stream 4 labeled **'LIQUID AMMONIA'**, both fully contained within the sheet borders. A legend in the bottom-left distinguishes between **PROCESS GAS**, **LOOP GAS**, and **PRODUCT** streams."
